cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, urllib.request
rows=[l.strip() for l in open('ob_accounts.txt') if l.strip()][-3:]
for row in rows:
    p=[x.strip() for x in row.split('|')]; num,key=p[0],p[1]
    try:
        r=urllib.request.Request('https://obscurify.ai/get_user_balance',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+key})
        b=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=30)).get('balance')
        req=urllib.request.Request('https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions',
            data=json.dumps({"model":"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"balas satu kata: ok"}],"max_tokens":10}).encode(),
            headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+key,'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        c=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=90))
        print(f"{num} saldo=${b} chat={c['choices'][0]['message']['content']!r}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(num,"ERR",type(e).__name__,str(e)[:100])
EOF
